professionalSummary.text: Data Analytics Engineer with 18 months of experience building and maintaining reconciliation data pipelines for a mid-sized acquirer, focusing on matching card-scheme settlement files against ledger entries.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included loader maintenance, exception investigation and release documentation for the reconciliation warehouse over roughly eighteen months in the finance engineering team.

experienceHighlights.text: Built and maintained a nightly loader for Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and general-ledger extracts using dbt models and Python pre-validation for checksums, reducing unmatched items by 35% over 18 months.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the nightly loader that ingests Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and the general-ledger extract into the reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and a Python pre-validation step for file checksums.

experienceHighlights.text: Investigated unmatched items daily with finance operations analysts, tracing exceptions to root causes (fee mismatches, timing differences, duplicate captures) and documenting resolutions in a shared exception log.
experienceHighlights.witness: Worked the daily unmatched-item queue with two finance operations analysts, tracing each exception to fee mismatches, timing differences or duplicate captures, and recorded the root cause and resolution in the shared exception log.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented pipeline changes at monthly change-window reviews with settlement operations and compliance, covering loader and matching key updates while deferring go-live approval to the finance engineering lead.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented pipeline changes at the monthly change-window review with settlement operations and compliance; my part covered the loader and the matching keys, while approval of the go-live date stayed with the finance engineering lead.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented data lineage for pipeline releases, including source files, transformation steps, and two known limitations (partial refunds and multi-currency fees) requiring manual review.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the lineage notes for the matching model, listing the source files, the transformation steps and the two known limitations (partial refunds and multi-currency fees) that still needed manual review.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Anonymized exception-log extract with root-cause taxonomy (fee mismatch, timing, duplicate capture, unknown) and SQL used to classify unmatched items, including warehouse query history for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: an anonymised exception-log extract with the root-cause taxonomy (fee mismatch, timing, duplicate capture, unknown) and the SQL used to classify unmatched items; the extract keeps the warehouse query history as a verification trail.

skills.witness: Built the nightly loader that ingests Visa and Mastercard settlement files (TC57/T112) and the general-ledger extract into the reconciliation warehouse on Snowflake, using dbt models and a Python pre-validation step for file checksums.
